title: Alacrity | Easy Shulker Boxes Support
description: Retexture of Easy Shulker Boxes in Alacrity style
body:
[](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity-easy-shulker-boxes-support) [](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/alacrity-easy-shulker-boxes-support) ---
An **unofficial compatibility pack** designed to align the aesthetics of [Easy Shulker Boxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes) mod with the [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity) resource pack. This pack is **100% completed** and **should be adjusted** using the `Configuration Menu`, as follows: - Set `Item Storage Highlight Sprite = Highlight` - Set `Item Storage Colors = Off` for better visuality. **Note:** - For the best experience, use this pack alongside [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity). - For Bug Report / Suggestion, please DM me on my **Discord (@thedatthai)**. **Credits:** - [Satellence](https://modrinth.com/user/Satellence) - Creator of Alacrity - [Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/user/Fuzs) - Creator of Easy Shulker Boxes - Special thanks to [JohnMC](https://modrinth.com/user/JohnMC) for his erudition and dedication. Without his support, this addon would never been possible. ## Showcase: ![Showcase (GUI)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7589d12d0354c2425d1bde20c407fd3bd95e9419.png)
